limitations: Registration uses validated immutable CPU closure snapshots; reset and equality checks are untimed.
Full JOIN PREPARE dispatch uses 24 synthetic workflows and native-style sparse leaf/LRU indices.
Controller, enqueue, writer and GPU capacity use CPU stand-ins; no real DMA, allocator or writer I/O.
The fixed clock is an ordinary lambda; reset, equality checking and counters are outside timing.
Synthetic case counts and CPU percentages do not establish online frequencies, throughput or JCT.
